identity.real_world_identity_notes: Period-car reporting identifies the Esperante GTLM with a Hewland sequential gearbox. AMS2 exposes six forward ratios and visibly models a sequential lever without paddles.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a D-shaped rim without an integrated display; exact diameter remains unknown.

notes: With Auto Clutch disabled, the car stalled when moving from rest without physical clutch input.
All six sequential-stick gears accepted clutch-free full-throttle upshifts with perceptible automatic cut.
Clutch-free downshifts were accepted and no automatic throttle blip was observed; authentic rev matching therefore requires the driver to blip the throttle manually.
Live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch disabled.
Standing-start clutch, six-speed sequential stick, automatic cut, no automatic blip, and the D-shaped no-display rim were directly observed.

confidence.basis: Exact simulator identity and behavior were directly tested; specialist period-car evidence independently establishes a Hewland sequential gearbox. Manual blipping is the driver-supplied rev-matching technique for the verified non-auto-blip downshift behavior.

claims.basis: Official release plus exact live CarModel and GT2_05 class observation.
Historical evidence establishes the sequential gearbox and direct AMS2 observation establishes the six-speed lever interface.

Direct current-game tests and cockpit inspection establish clutch-free sequential downshifts with no automatic blip; manual throttle blipping is therefore the required authentic driver-supplied rev-matching technique.

driver_summary: Hewland sequential six-speed. Upshift flat and the car cuts. Blip every downshift yourself: nothing rev-matches for you, and an unmatched downshift will lock the driven wheels just as you are asking them to turn.
